message: Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/openthread && grep -rn "GetCommissionerSessionId\|CommissionerSessionIdTlv" src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.hpp | head

message.content:
The vulnerability is specifically about the missing validation when reading the Commissioning Session ID TLV. This is the OOB read in `GetCommissionerSessionId()` in the first loop.

Let me look at the `CommissionerSessionIdTlv::GetCommissionerSessionId()` implementation.
